method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); the repeals by the Wage Theft Amendment Act 2025 encoded as does-not-arise answers that name the amending Act; shared definitions, the repeal table, the s 71(2) duty as one regulative rule and the penalty table in a rules module, the questions in a seat module importing it; the regulative rule run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Workforce Inspectorate Victoria Act 2020 (Vic), formerly the Wage Theft Act 2020, Act No. 21/2020, Version No. 005 (incorporating amendments as at 17 December 2025), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/workforce-inspectorate-victoria-act-2020.txt (committed text sha256 428c5cb3d9a36ae005b6c022fecc916fcf89dd097b8e92d5a49574259f55eba8), converted from the Word file saved by hand by the owner on 2026-11-07. Not deposited and asked as facts or left in penalty units: regulations under ss 79 and 83, the value of a penalty unit, the Sentencing Act 1991, the Project Development and Construction Management Act 1994, the Interpretation of Legislation Act 1984, the repealed text.

seat: a worker who reports underpayment (or public construction) to the Workforce Inspectorate Victoria, or is thinking of doing so, and who may suffer detriment for it (wiv-seat.l4)

checks.result: 154 assertions written, 154 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read; the output prints each diagnostic twice. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Focus: what is left of the Act after the Wage Theft Amendment Act 2025 (No. 35/2025), from the seat of a worker who reports underpayment. In: the repeals (s 1(a), s 5, Part 2 ss 6-18, s 20(1)(c)-(e), s 21(2), Part 4 ss 32-62, Part 5 Div 1 ss 63-65, ss 66-69, Part 5 Div 3 former ss 71-73, ss 76, 78) as does-not-arise answers naming the repealing section; s 2(2); s 3 (worker, workplace, public construction); s 20(1)(ha), (ia), (ib), (k); ss 22, 24(1), 69A, 70, 71, 75, 77, 80, 81; the penalties. Out: ss 1(b)-(d), 2(1), 4, 19, the other heads of s 20, 21, 23, 24(2)-(3), 25-31, 74, 79, 82, 83 (machinery or an official's office). Reasons in NOTES.md.
